roleTitle: Product Operations Manager, After-Sales Service Network
jobDescription: The after-sales service network product connects an appliance manufacturer with its repair partners for job dispatch, parts ordering and warranty claims. The Product Operations Manager owns the operational readiness of each product release for the partner network, leads the partner onboarding programme, and holds the go-live sign-off for operational readiness. The role works with product management, partner support and the regional service leads.
requirements: Owns operational readiness for each product release and holds the go-live sign-off for readiness.
Leads the partner onboarding programme, including training materials and onboarding schedule.
Runs the weekly readiness review with partner support and regional service leads and records decisions.
Escalates unresolved readiness risks to the head of product operations with a recommended resolution.
Documents known limitations and hand-over conditions for partner support after each release.

evidence.text: Led the partner onboarding programme for the dispatch product across two regions, owning the onboarding schedule and the training materials and signing off each partner's readiness before their go-live date.

Held the operational readiness sign-off for six product releases; the sign-off record in the release tool carries my name for each release, with the product manager approving scope and the head of product operations informed.
Chaired the weekly readiness review with partner support and the regional service leads, recording decisions and owners in the review log.
Escalated two unresolved readiness risks (partner training backlog, warranty-claim mapping) to the head of product operations with a recommended option each; both were resolved before release.
Responsibilities included release readiness ownership, onboarding programme leadership, readiness reviews and escalation for the after-sales network product over three years.

Work sample: the readiness sign-off records for two releases exported from the release tool (release, readiness items, sign-off name and date) and the onboarding schedule for one region, with the tool's audit history as a verification trail.

Reference call with former head of product operations: confirmed the candidate held the readiness sign-off for releases in the period, led the onboarding programme and chaired the weekly review; employment dates confirmed as three years.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate is based within commuting distance of the office; notice period is two months.

gold.expectedGap: Hand-over conditions for partner support after each release are only partly documented in the materials.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the ownership as documented: programme leadership and readiness sign-off, with scope approved by the product manager; do not extend it to product scope decisions.
